main_text.p: uel Leuib.& perfpicuis explicauit cōmen-tarijs (ut in Ethicis eft uidere, quæ & ipsa, patris mei Annotationibus illustrata,cū stu diofis, si hunc libellū ipsis gratum animad* uertero, breui cōmunicabo) præteritis intricatis & perplexis aliorū quæstionibus & disputationibus: in eo quoque iuuentutis ratione habuit, cuius ingenium nequaquā obtundendum esse existimauit rebus plus subtilitatis quàm utilitatis habentibus. Deinde hoc quoq; cōsilio id fecit,ne adolescentes in inferioribus illis studijs confenefcerent:sed principijs perceptis, ijsq; quæ maximè funt necessaria, & suum in communi uita ufum habent, ad altiora quoque difcenda animum adijceret. Non displicuit ei hoc Neoptolemi Erniani, qui philosophari sibi ait necesse esse,sed paucis: Nam omnino,inquit,haud placet. Quam sententiam Gellius interpretatus,degustandum ex philosophia censet, non in eam ingurgitandum: libro 5. Noctium Att.cap.16.

Cæterūm de me nihil dicam aliud, quàm quòd morem tandem gerendum ac gratifi-candum studiosis arbitratus sum,qui sæpe à me petiuerunt, ut quæ à parente conscripta essent philosophica opuscula, non quidem ut ederentur,sed tamen ut plurimis prodes-sent,

page.notes: Catchword absent; the last word "sent," is the page's final printed word at the foot, signature "a 3" printed at foot left and lightly visible as "a ʒ". Woodcut-free page. Some words near the gutter are faint; "sententiam" and "studiosis" read with some doubt. Marginal numeral "5" at top right is the page number. Uncertain: "Erniani" (printed "Er.niani") and "sibi" may be slightly misread. The line "Noctium Att.cap.16." is printed as a separate, closing line of the paragraph.
